title: Expand ESLint type-aware rules to all TypeScript/Astro files
description: Type-aware ESLint rules (@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any, no-unsafe-assignment, no-unsafe-member-access, consistent-type-imports) are currently only enforced on 6 specific files in website/eslint.config.mjs. The rest of the codebase is unchecked. Expand these rules incrementally to cover all .ts and .astro files under website/src/. Start by auditing which files already pass, enable for those in bulk, then fix remaining files one batch at a time.
